_note: v2.8 plan 60 B14 (no-model lane): an edit to book A waiting in ST's 1 s world-info save debounce survives an immediate save of another book. Control: ST's own immediate save of book B cancels A's pending save (the server keeps the old text). Treatment: the story's own immediate write to book B (file-mode checkpoint world_info on /cp activate, inside the debounce window) saves A's pending edit too. Fetch order and timing are recorded so the treatment cannot pass by A's debounce firing first. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-60-b14-wi-pending.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); const wi = await import('/scripts/world-info.js'); const A = 'SO-V28-60 B14 Book A'; const B = 'SO-V28-60 B14 Book B'; for (const name of [A, B]) if (wi.world_names.includes(name)) throw new Error('fixture book already exists: ' + name); const entry = (uid, comment, key, content) => ({ uid, comment, key, keysecondary: [], content, constant: false, selective: true, disable: false, position: 1, depth: 4, order: 100, probability: 100, useProbability: true }); await wi.createNewWorldInfo(A); await wi.saveWorldInfo(A, { entries: { 0: entry(0, 'Note', ['harbor'], 'A-original') } }, true); await wi.createNewWorldInfo(B); await wi.saveWorldInfo(B, { entries: { 0: entry(0, 'Gate entry', ['gate'], 'B gated text') } }, true); const server = async (name) => { const r = await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name }) }); if (!r.ok) throw new Error('server read failed for ' + name + ': ' + r.status); return r.json(); }; const pause = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const editA = async (text) => { const data = await wi.loadWorldInfo(A); data.entries[0].content = text; wi.saveWorldInfo(A, data); return Date.now(); }; const root = (ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator'].settings ??= {}); globalThis.__b14 = { wi, A, B, server, pause, editA, was: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(root.worldInfo ?? {})) }; await globalThis.storyOrchestratorScanGating.requestFile(); return { mode: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().worldInfo.gatingMode, a: (await server(A)).entries[0].content };

steps.eval: const b = globalThis.__b14; globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); for (let i = 0; i < 50 && (await b.server(b.B)).entries[0].disable !== true; i += 1) await b.pause(200); const rest = (await b.server(b.B)).entries[0].disable; if (rest !== true) throw new Error('file mode did not start the gated entry off: disable=' + rest); await b.pause(1500); const t0 = await b.editA('A-control-edit'); const fresh = await b.wi.loadWorldInfo(b.B); await b.wi.saveWorldInfo(b.B, fresh, true); const savedB = Date.now() - t0; await b.pause(2500); const onServer = (await b.server(b.A)).entries[0].content; if (savedB >= 1000) throw new Error('control: the host save of B came ' + savedB + ' ms after the edit, outside the debounce window'); if (onServer !== 'A-original') throw new Error('control: the host save did not cancel the pending edit (server holds ' + JSON.stringify(onServer) + '), so the hazard is not reproduced here'); return { control: 'pending edit lost by the host save, as expected', savedBAfterMs: savedB, serverA: onServer };

const b = globalThis.__b14; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const posts = []; const original = globalThis.fetch; globalThis.fetch = async (input, init) => { const url = String(typeof input === 'string' ? input : input?.url ?? ''); if (url.includes('/api/worldinfo/edit')) { let name = null; try { name = JSON.parse(String(init?.body ??
